directive.thread_id: cloud job 2026-11-03: pieces, piece coverage and rows with no test, in the one judge
directive.quote: Avery, 2026-11-03: every piece of every file of his gauntlet tree is a row with a check or a recorded reason, never one row per file and never a byte slice; all his checks are one tree in one list, one judge. Port one to one from old trillion.

old_copy.deleted_with: old trillion removes scripts/method-atoms.mjs and sweepAtoms (with scripts/method-sources.mjs --coverage and its tests in test/method-sources.test.mjs) and calls tool:split-a-document-into-pieces and tool:check-every-piece-is-covered; this session may not write to old trillion, so the PR names it as open

preserve: atomsOf: one paragraph, list item, table row or fenced block under its headings is one piece; titles, rules and table headers are not
a key is the heading path and the lead (the bold opening, or the first eight words), numbered when two pieces share one
an identity is 1f: and the BLAKE3 of the whitespace-folded text
allowed_deltas: the header names its new home and shapes
lead is exported, so a piece row says its lead
pieceRow and pieceRows make the row a person keeps in list:checks (id piece- and the first 24 hex of the identity, kind piece, sources per place it stands), one row per identity across files
banned_substitutions: a byte slice in place of a piece
an identity of anything but the folded text
